FAQ

Before you come.

The things you might be wondering.

Do I need to know anyone?

No. Come alone. Someone from Boulder Culture will be at the meeting point.

Is it free?

Yes. If a gathering is at a place that sells food or drinks, anything you choose to order is separate.

Is this a club or part of CU?

Neither. There’s no membership, and Boulder Culture is independent of CU Boulder.

When’s the first one?

The date and location aren’t confirmed yet. Email Leo if you’d like to hear when they are.

Can I help?

Yes. offer a space or lead a gathering. The foundation is still forming, is not yet a 501(c)(3), and isn’t taking donations on this site.
